description_en: Lists the databases that the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is authorized to access
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-databases --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl32wdd --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, 20 entries are returned.
Specify a value for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database. This parameter supports only exact matches
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例名称。精确搜索
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the database. Valid values:

Local: a local database

Rds: an ApsaraDB RDS database

PolarDB: a PolarDB database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例的来源。取值：
Local：本地数据库
Rds：RDS数据库
PolarDB：PolarDB数据库

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source instance. This parameter supports only exact matches
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the source instance. You can use this parameter to filter the results.

Normal: The instance is running.

RemoteRelease: The instance is released
parameters.help_zh:
按实例状态过滤

Normal：正常
RemoteRelease ：已释放
parameters.name: source_instance_state
